phases.action: Seated Counter establishes fixed downward gaze and balanced ledger; wrist prepares at first-line start, no glance toward water.
phases.drawing_policy: Intentional setup holds allowed; any preparatory articulation uses three-frame drawing changes.

phases.action: Cut to pen/page close-up at established contact. Articulated fingers and wrist guide nib along the first line, with varied short ink strokes and deliberate spacing; end settles on paper.
phases.drawing_policy: 15 active three-frame exposures with registered action-specific hand/wrist drawings; ink follows actual nib contact.

phases.action: Release first-line contact, lift nib clear, move through a shallow return arc, descend at second-line start and land without a positional jump.
phases.drawing_policy: Nine connected three-frame drawings. No ink while nib is clear.

phases.action: Write the second line below the first on the same paper plane, advancing with varied finger/wrist articulation. Do not translate the first-line bank downward.
phases.drawing_policy: 17 active three-frame exposures, separately drawn against the second-line path.

phases.action: Complete final mark, release nib, make a small controlled finishing lift, then settle wrist without adding another line.
phases.drawing_policy: Five connected three-frame exposures, ending in a stable lift/settle pose.

phases.action: Brief intentional hold with two completed newly written lines visible; no gaze change or extra story action.
phases.drawing_policy: 12-frame punctuation hold explicitly allowed, no claim of active writing here.
